title: Sargon II
summary: King of Assyria, the second "Sardanapalus" of the chroniclers in CFAH's reading.
description: King of Assyria, the second "Sardanapalus" of the chroniclers in CFAH's reading. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

reign.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-34: Sardanapalus II—Sargon II: Second Median Revolt: 705–700 B.C."
reign.note: Start of the reign ("whose reign began in 720 or 721").

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-34: Sardanapalus II—Sargon II: Second Median Revolt: 705–700 B.C."
death.note: "except that he died in 705". Berossus counted the death as 706 (open question I5).
